name: Magnifi
shortDescription: Links brokerage accounts on a $0 plan. Premium is $99 per year.
longDescription: Magnifi is an investing app that links accounts and answers portfolio questions. There is a $0 plan with account overview and portfolio analysis, and Premium is $99 per year for forecasts and scenario tests. This is not financial advice.
pricingNotes: Premium is $99 per year on the pricing page. The page does not list a single monthly rate. Not financial advice.
bestFor: Linking brokerage accounts and reading a portfolio summary on the free plan
notIdealFor: Someone who needs forecasts without paying for Premium
Anyone treating this card as financial advice
strength: There is a $0 plan that can link accounts, and Premium is $99 per year for forecasts.
weakness: Forecasts and scenario tests sit on the paid Premium plan, and fund fees can still apply.

useCaseFit.manage-portfolio: Links brokerage accounts on the $0 plan and adds forecasts on Premium.
